programmes.d: Itsuki claims that Quon is his sister, but other information surfaces that indicate otherwise.
Shamiko and Momo enter Mikan's heart to negotiate with Ugallu, the entity responsible for the magical girl's curse!
Forces make a move to take control of Quon; TERRA gains use of a new weapon, the Vermillion.
Hiraku won't waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.
Three young children study within their master's vast mansion; one child finds a Dolem living in the ruins beneath and wants to protect it.
As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.
Now knowing what he truly is, Ayato struggles to make a choice between remaining with his team and returning to Tokyo Jupiter.
Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.
TERRA sends Elvy to catch Ayato and Quon; they must bring back the RahXephon, their best defense against the Mulian invasion.
Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.
Ayato attempts an escape with Hiroko as the situation in Tokyo Jupiter deteriorates.
With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.
Megumi and Elvy reunite with the Vermillion; Hiroko keeps a disturbing secret from Ayato.
A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.
Upon returning to TERRA, Ayato finds a new commander in charge and a familiar face by his side.
Hiraku realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.
Tempers flare as Isshiki's takeover of TERRA begins to take its toll; Mamoru finally learns what happened to Hiroko when she came over with Ayato.
They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.
Ayato has an encounter with Mishima, who reveals her true purpose for showing herself to him.
Hiraku's offhand remark leads to a series of events that conclude with a merchant, establishing trade relationships with The Great Tree Village.
Kunugi regains command of TERRA, but faces a fateful decision when Masayoshi demands the RahXephon.
Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. “Attempts” being the keyword.
The survivors begin to pick up the pieces of their shattered lives and try to slowly rebuild; Ayato appears and Quon makes her final move.
News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested in the good news.
As the battle rages on between TERRA's forces and the Mulian invaders, Ayato must finally choose which path he must take.
Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.
Ayato comes to terms with everything he has come to understand and fights Quon to restore his past.
After finding out Latifah's reliance on the park, Kanie doubles his efforts into making sure they reach their target visitor count in time. Will it be enough?

Maddie, a bullied teen, receives help from a stranger online; Caspian, a teen loner and math genius, struggles with his parents' toxic relationship; Chanda, a computer engineer, secretly meets with a rival tech giant.
The park is on the brink of its deadline, and every cast member is giving their all to get the final visitors to come, but they might be too late!

Ellen fights with Logorhythms over control of David's consciousness; Maddie learns the truth about her father's death and meets a stranger who wants to help; Caspian stumbles on Maddie's crisis on the dark web; a new consciousness is uploaded.
Takumi narrates a strange retelling of the legend of Momotaro with Misaki as the titular character herself.
Sakura, an avid fan of rock band Yumemishi, is in love with its vocalist Kuuga. She invites her friends to a party with the band, but Kuuga has his eyes on Misaki instead.

Chanda's life is on a loop; Maddie and David make up for time lost; Ellen tries to move on from her dead husband; Caspian watches his parents' marriage disintegrate while trying to start a romance of his own.
Usui meets Misaki's mom and helps her, and she invites him home for tea. Misaki drags him from her home. When her friends see them leave together, what else would they think?
It's the Sports Festival, and the boys have decided that the Grand Prize is a kiss from a horrified Sakura. Misaki competes to save her, despite all efforts to disqualify her.

David learns how to maximize his power from an unlikely source; Maddie and Ellen find out they aren't alone; Cary questions the plan; Caspian gets closer to Hannah and the truth; Chanda seeks revenge.
Aratake, the strongest delinquent in school, can't believe Naoya, a former gang leader, has gone soft; the gang abducts Yukimura, whom they mistake for Naoya's girlfriend.
Caspian fights to learn the truth about his identity; an unlikely team builds David a new home in a familiar place; David and Laurie fight to evade those who are trying to delete them.
The Student Council plans an open house at Seika High to boost female enrollment. However, a girl-hating freshman, Soutarou, goes to extreme measures to derail their efforts.
Soutarou is shocked to find that Misaki was able to outlast his little game. Misaki has a special punishment in mind for the freshman at the upcoming Open House.
The flaw takes its toll on Laurie; Caspian's and Maddie's worlds finally collide; Chanda builds his own reality.
It's the summer vacation, and the Maid Latte crew has been invited to Satsuki's sister's beach resort. Aoi tags along, too, but why did Satsuki bring Usui?
Caspian searches for a new life; the superpowers catch up; Laurie and Chanda consider moves that could change the world forever.
It's the second day of vacation, and Aoi needs Misa's help to win the beach volleyball tournament! The winners are crowned Beach Prince and Princess, so why is Usui competing?
The Miyabigaoka Student Council aims to buy out Maid Latte and replace it with a butler cafe. The only way for Misa to stop this is to enter the footman auditions in disguise.
America enters the cloud; Caspian takes over; Chanda forms a new rebellion; Cody continues the fight; David enters the battle; Waxman gets off the fence.

Nozaki's friend and fellow manga artist Mikoshiba pays a visit. Considering Mikoshiba is pretty much Nozaki's foil, Sakura can't figure out how or why the two are friends.

The group has various repeated, awkward attempts at love, and it appears some people are catching on to who they are in Nozaki's manga.

Nozaki is up to his usual social experiments, and this time Sakura isn't the only one being tricked and observed! This time the guys are the focus.
After numerous failed attempts at grabbing Nozaki's attention, it finally seems as though Sakura may have the perfect opportunity.

Yuko didn't have horns or a tail when she went to bed last night! Now her mom's revealing the deep dark secret their family's been hiding for generations - What's going on!?
America enters the cloud; Caspian takes over; Chanda forms a new rebellion; Cody continues the fight; David enters the battle; Waxman gets off the fence.
Well it's time for Yuko to murderize a magical girl - but not before she gets in some exercise and spends her allowance, of course.
Lilith contacts Yuko in her dreams with vital information she must remember. After all, Yuko needs all the help she can get! Say, why is Momo helping her anyways?
Akane copes with her trauma by being popular and working hard to make people like her, but one boy in her class doesn't care about her at all.
Wait a minute; there's a switch on the bottom of Yuko's ancestor statue. What happens if it's turned on? Later, Yuko needs cash fast cause she owes Momo A LOT of money!
Reincarnated as the son of Baron Kagenou, Cid bides his time as Background Character A while preparing for the day he can finally become the Eminence in Shadow.
Momo finally meets Ryoko. Later, the accident-prone Yuko must carry a FRAGILE and VALUABLE laptop home with her. What could possibly go wrong?
The princess is supposed to reject the background character's confession, not accept it.
Yuko will need to go deeper into Momo's subconscious so she can implant the idea that will change everything! Perhaps compassion can triumph where fighting has failed.
The mistake those with power make is believing that they are the ones in control.
A change of fortune can only mean one thing: FOOD. Later, Yuko learns the hard way that she and Momo have vastly different definitions of "training."
Cid is not facing a minion, but a would-be knight of the rounds; an atomic bomb has no reason to fear the gnashing of a lowly pest.
Mikan finally makes her debut, and Yuko's anxiety spikes to even higher levels! Is the magical girl here to murderize Yuko or for another reason?
While Iris seeks a bright mind to study an artifact, Cid visits a popular store; in the dark corners of the city, someone commits murders in Shadow Garden's name.
Yuko and Momo finally resume their duel. In the end, there can be only one winner - who will receive the higher exam score? Later, Mikan takes Yuko to a zombie horror movie.
Cid gets a report from Nu about powerful cult members lurking in the Royal Capital; he is too distracted by the upcoming fencing tournament to notice.
Look out Yuko, Shion's up to something - and she won't rest until she runs her experiments! Then, can Yuko and Momo keep a secret from Ryoko?
Cid sacrifices his life to save Rose; unbeknownst to anyone else, Cid survives exactly as planned; his counterattack can begin.
